t: This is Brook Street in Mayfair, which runs from Hanover Square to Grosvenor Square. It is named after the Tyburn, which it crossed, and was developed in the first half of the eighteenth century. The grand terraced houses here have been home to many notable people. Henry Holland, later Viscount Knutsford, was born on this street. He served as Secretary of State for the Colonies. Walter Cunliffe, Governor of the Bank of England through the First World War, lived here. Lewis Harcourt, who held the same colonial post, died here.
